text:
Which statement about the resistance of a metal wire is correct?
A
The resistance is directly proportional to its length and directly proportional to its
cross-sectional area.
B
The resistance is directly proportional to its length and inversely proportional to its
cross-sectional area.
C
The resistance is inversely proportional to its length and directly proportional to its
cross-sectional area.
D
The resistance is inversely proportional to its length and inversely proportional to its
cross-sectional area.
